ProgramUnit.Name: RUN_OTHER_FORM_OLD
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE RUN_OTHER_FORM_old (p_name in varchar2 , P_type in varchar2 )IS
p_exec_name varchar2(12);
author varchar2(10);
module_name varchar2(200);
mnemonic_name varchar2(8);

BEGIN
 
 if p_type = 'M' then
 mnemonic_name := p_name;
 select A.exec_name, b.descrip into
 p_exec_name, module_name
 from fcn a, menu_item b
 where a.fcn_id = b.fcn_id and
 b.mnemonic = p_name and
 rownum = 1;
 end if;

 if p_type = 'X' then
 p_exec_name := p_name;
 mnemonic_name := p_name;
 select b.mnemonic, b.descrip into
 mnemonic_name, module_name
 from fcn a, menu_item b
 where a.fcn_id = b.fcn_id and
 a.exec_name = p_exec_name and
 rownum = 1;
 end if;


 if :global.db_id = 'N/A'
 then
 begin
 select
 decode(substr(global_name,1,1),'W','D',substr(global_name,1,3))
 into :global.db_id
 from global_name;
 exception
 when others then handle_error;
 end;
 end if;

 if substr(:global.db_id,1,1) = 'D' Then
 begin
 select Program_author into author from fcn
 where exec_name = p_exec_name ;
 Exception
 When no_data_found then
 author := 'ISQA'; 
 End;
 module_name := module_name ||' By '||author;
 end if;

 p_exec_name := p_exec_name ||'.fmx';
 module_name := mnemonic_name ||': '||
 module_name ;
 :global.module_name := module_name;
 CALL_FORM( lower(p_exec_name));
 if form_failure then
 message ('Err: Module ' || p_exec_name ||
 ' not found, contact systems.');
 bell;
 end if;
exception
 when no_data_found then
 message ('Err: Module ' || p_exec_name ||
 ' not found, contact systems.');
 bell;
end;

ProgramUnit.Name: POPULATE_SELECTION

PROCEDURE populate_selection IS
rg_name VARCHAR2(10) := 'PF_GROUP'; 
 rg_id RecordGroup; 
 gc_id GroupColumn; 
 h_group_row_count number;
 ref_record_number number;
 curr_group_row number;
 flag number;
 errcode NUMBER; 
BEGIN
 
 flag := 0;
 rg_id := Find_Group(rg_name); 
 IF Id_Null(rg_id) THEN 
 rg_id := Create_Group(rg_name);
 END IF;

 gc_id := Add_Group_Column(rg_id, 'inter_code',CHAR_COLUMN,5); 
 gc_id := Add_Group_Column(rg_id, 'inter_desc',CHAR_COLUMN,50); 

 go_block('donation_interdictions');
 first_record;
 loop
 if :donation_interdictions.chk_box = 'Y' then
 :ctrl_block2.lv_select := 'TRUE';
 add_group_row(rg_id,END_OF_GROUP);
 curr_group_row := get_group_row_count(rg_id);
 set_group_char_cell('PF_GROUP.inter_code',curr_group_row,:donation_interdictions.inter_code);
 set_group_char_cell('PF_GROUP.inter_desc',curr_group_row,:donation_interdictions.inter_desc);
 end if;
 if :system.last_record = 'TRUE' then
 exit;
 else
 next_record;
 end if;
 end loop;
 /* populate user selection back to dvt_block */
 hide_window('window2');
 h_group_row_count := get_group_row_count(rg_id);
 go_block('dvi_block');
 last_record;
 ref_record_number := to_number(:system.cursor_record);
 if :system.record_status = 'NEW' then
 flag := 0;
 end if;
 for i in 1 .. h_group_row_count
 loop 
 :dvi_block.inter_code := get_group_char_cell('PF_GROUP.inter_code',i); 
 :dvi_block.inter_desc := get_group_char_cell('PF_GROUP.inter_desc',i); 
 create_record;
 end loop;
 IF NOT Id_Null(rg_id) THEN 
 Delete_Group( rg_id ); 
 END IF; 
 go_record(ref_record_number); 
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: POPULATE_DONATION_INTER
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE populate_donation_inter IS
 cursor c1_don is
 Select distinct di.inter_code, vi.inter_desc
 from donation_interdictions di, valid_interdictions vi
 where di.inter_code = vi.inter_code
 and di.group_id = :ctrl_block.grp_value
 and di.group_mode = :ctrl_block.grp_mode
 and di.chapter_id = :global.chapter_id -- MLT 1691 -- V05
 and :ctrl_block.s_chp_date between di.insert_date and
 nvl(di.term_date, :ctrl_block.s_chp_date + 10);

 /* di.inter_code in ( select inter_code from
 valid_interdictions vi,valid_acl_codes va,valid_user_access_classes vu
 where vu.user_id = :banner.user_id and
 vu.access_class = va.access_class and
 va.access_code_type = 'INTER' and
 va.access_code_value = vi.inter_code and
 vu.inter_level > vi.view_level and
 sysdate between vi.eff_date and nvl(vi.term_date,sysdate+1) and
 sysdate between vu.eff_date and nvl(vu.term_date,sysdate+1)
 union
 Select inter_code from
 valid_interdictions vi,valid_acl_codes va,valid_user_access_classes vu
 where vu.user_id = :banner.user_id and
 va.access_class = vu.access_class and
 va.access_code_type = 'INTER' and
 va.access_code_value = 'ALL' and
 vu.inter_level > vi.view_level and
 sysdate between vi.eff_date and nvl(vi.term_date,sysdate+1) and
 sysdate between vu.eff_date and nvl(vu.term_date,sysdate+1) );
 */
BEGIN
 go_block('donation_interdictions');
 clear_block(no_validate);
 for c1 in c1_don loop
 :donation_interdictions.inter_code := c1.inter_code;
 :donation_interdictions.inter_desc := c1.inter_desc;
 create_record;
 end loop;
 go_block('donation_interdictions');
 first_record;
END;

PROCEDURE set_control_block_items(action IN varchar2) IS
BEGIN
 if :system.cursor_item != 'CTRL_BLOCK.GRP_MODE' then
 item_change('ctrl_block.grp_mode',action);
 end if;
 if :system.cursor_item != 'CTRL_BLOCK.GRP_VALUE' then
 item_change('ctrl_block.grp_value',action);
 end if;
 
 item_change('ctrl_block.pb_grp_mode',action);
 item_change('ctrl_block.pb_grp_value',action);
 item_change('ctrl_block.pb_retrieve',action);
 if action = 'E' then
 set_item_property('ctrl_block.pb_grp_mode',NAVIGABLE,property_false);
 set_item_property('ctrl_block.pb_grp_value',NAVIGABLE,property_false);
 end if; 
END;

RecordGroup.Name: RG_GRP_MODE
RecordGroup.RecordGroupQuery: select code,description from valid_master_codes where code_type = 'GPMOD' and sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate+1) order by sort_sequence_1

RecordGroup.Name: RG_TERM_REASON
RecordGroup.RecordGroupQuery: select code,description from valid_master_codes where code_type = 'INTRM' and sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate+1)

RecordGroup.Name: RG_ACCESS_INTER
RecordGroup.RecordGroupQuery: select distinct vi.inter_type,vm.description from valid_interdictions vi, valid_master_codes vm where vm.code_type = 'INTER' and vi.inter_type = vm.code and inter_code in ( select access_code_value from valid_acl_codes where access_code_type = 'INTER' and access_class in (select access_class from valid_user_access_classes where user_id = 'SBE' ) )

RecordGroup.Name: RG_GRP_VALUE

 where group_mode = :ctrl_block.grp_mode

 nvl(term_date, :ctrl_block.s_chp_date + 10)

DECLARE

 l_print_id VARCHAR2(40);
 l_error VARCHAR2(1000);
BEGIN
 populate_chapter_ID(l_chp_id, l_print_id, l_error);
 IF l_error IS NOT NULL THEN
 IF l_error in ('9776','9777') THEN
 show_error(l_error); -- Message Type
 check_package_failure;
 ELSE
 message('Err: ' || sqlcode || '-' || SUBSTR(sqlerrm, 1, 100));
 pause;
 END IF; 
 exit_form(no_validate);
 ELSE
 :global.chapter_id := l_chp_id;
 :global.user_printer_id := l_print_id;
 END IF;
EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS THEN
 message('Err: ' || sqlcode || '-' || SUBSTR(sqlerrm, 1, 100));pause;
 exit_form(no_validate); 
END;
